title: Socratic-MCTS: Test-Time Visual Reasoning by Asking the Right Questions
authors_zh: David Acuna；Ximing Lu；Jaehun Jung；Hyunwoo Kim；Amlan Kar；Sanja Fidler；Yejin Choi
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A test-time MCTS that makes subquestion generation and agreement-weighted visual reasoning explicit.
Socratic-MCTS 在冻结的视觉语言模型输出中插入子问题—子答案对，以 MCTS 方式延展视觉推理，并用内部一致性投票选择答案。
why: It broadens Track 5 beyond text math: visual search traces need node-level prompts, answers, agreement scores, and stopping data to be auditable.
inclusion_reason: It broadens Track 5 beyond text math: visual search traces need node-level prompts, answers, agreement scores, and stopping data to be auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official EMNLP 2025 paper asks whether a frozen, non-reasoning vision-language model can produce a longer and more useful reasoning trajectory at test time without fine-tuning, supervision, or architectural changes. Direct answering and ordinary CoT prompting may leave relevant visual or world knowledge fragmented, while token-level search is poorly aligned with the semantic decisions needed for multimodal questions. Socratic-MCTS therefore searches over which intermediate question to ask next.

The evaluation surface is a multiple-choice visual question, and the process object is a tree of subquestion–subanswer nodes, compositional rollouts, extracted answer choices, heuristic confidence weights, visit/value statistics, and exit decisions. The feedback contract is internal agreement from the same frozen model, not an external correctness verifier. The paper is a test-time search recipe and scaling study; no new training dataset or official tree/trace release was verified.

EMNLP 2025 正式论文研究一个问题：冻结的非推理视觉语言模型能否在无需 fine-tuning、监督或架构修改的情况下，于测试时产生更长且更有用的推理轨迹。直接作答和普通 CoT prompting 可能无法连接分散的视觉或世界知识，而 token 级搜索也不适合表达多模态问题中的语义决策。Socratic-MCTS 因而搜索“下一步该问什么中间问题”。

评测表面是多项选择视觉问题，过程对象则是由 subquestion–subanswer 节点、compositional rollout、提取后的答案选项、启发式置信权重、访问/价值统计和退出决策组成的树。反馈契约来自同一冻结模型的内部一致性，而非外部正确性 verifier。该论文是测试时搜索配方与 scaling study；未核实到新的训练数据集或官方树/轨迹发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Socratic-MCTS defines an action as a generated subquestion and a node state as that subquestion paired with an answer. A question policy proposes the next actions from the current trajectory, while an answer policy answers each subquestion in isolation from the image; the experiments use the same InternVL2.5-78B model for both roles. UCT balances the accumulated node value against exploration.

To estimate a node, the method appends diverse wrap-up transitions and samples eight short completions. A parser extracts canonical multiple-choice answers, a heuristic downweights verbose or degenerate outputs, and weighted majority agreement supplies the rollout value. Direct-exit nodes allow an answer to terminate a path, while an initial-confidence threshold can skip search entirely. Compared with Least-To-Most prompting, the decomposition is searched and value-guided; compared with ordinary MCTS, actions are semantic subquestions. Internal agreement remains a judgment-required proxy and can be confidently wrong.

Socratic-MCTS 把 action 定义为生成的 subquestion，把 node state 定义为该 subquestion 与 answer 的配对。Question policy 根据当前轨迹提出下一步 action，answer policy 则只依据图像独立回答每个 subquestion；实验中两个角色均使用同一 InternVL2.5-78B。UCT 在累计节点价值与探索之间进行平衡。

为估计节点价值，方法附加多样化 wrap-up transition，并采样八个较短 completion。Parser 提取规范化多选答案，启发式规则降低冗长或退化输出的权重，再由加权多数一致性给出 rollout value。Direct-exit node 允许答案终止路径，初始置信度阈值则可直接跳过搜索。与 Least-To-Most prompting 相比，分解过程经过搜索和价值引导；与普通 MCTS 相比，action 是语义 subquestion。内部一致性仍只是需要判断的代理信号，也可能自信地出错。

title: Method
方法
html:
The input is an image plus a multiple-choice question. InternVL2.5-78B first provides an initial answer and confidence estimate; the reported search gate skips MCTS when confidence exceeds 0.9. Otherwise, the subquestion policy and isolated-answer policy run at temperature 0.6. The first tree level expands up to six subquestions and later levels up to three. A node terminates when the model produces no answer or degenerates into repetitive output. UCT uses exploration constant 1.4.

Each value estimate composes the partial path, appends one of eight wrap-up phrases, and obtains eight answer completions. The method parses each completion to a canonical choice and assigns a normalized heuristic weight; reaching maximum length without a valid answer receives weight zero. Weighted answer agreement is backpropagated through the tree. Direct-exit nodes omit the exploration term to reduce their special-node bias. The final answer is selected through the search and internal-agreement statistics rather than a benchmark label.

Experiments use a frozen model with single runs: 40 MCTS iterations for MMMU-PRO and 20 for MMStar and the English multiple-choice subset of MathVista test-mini. The paper also compares Direct Answer, greedy CoT, and a depth-3 multimodal Least-To-Most baseline. There is no model training. Exact prompt packages, transition lists, per-node seeds, tree logs, parser implementation, and executable code were not confirmed as official releases.

输入是一张图像与一道多项选择题。InternVL2.5-78B 先给出初始答案和置信估计；报告中的 search gate 在置信度超过 0.9 时跳过 MCTS。否则，subquestion policy 与 isolated-answer policy 均以 temperature 0.6 运行。树的第一层最多扩展六个 subquestion，后续层最多三个。若模型无法产生答案，或输出退化为重复内容，节点终止。UCT 的 exploration constant 为 1.4。

每次 value estimation 会组合当前部分路径，附加八种 wrap-up phrase 之一，并获得八个答案 completion。方法把每个 completion 解析为规范选项并赋予归一化启发式权重；若达到最大长度仍无有效答案，则权重为零。加权答案一致性沿树回传。Direct-exit node 在 UCT 中省略 exploration term，以减轻特殊节点偏置。最终答案由搜索与内部一致性统计选择，而非 benchmark 标签直接选择。

实验使用冻结模型且只运行一次：MMMU-PRO 使用 40 次 MCTS iteration，MMStar 与 MathVista test-mini 的英文多选子集使用 20 次。论文还比较 Direct Answer、greedy CoT 和深度为 3 的多模态 Least-To-Most。流程不含模型训练。本次未确认官方发布完整 prompt 包、transition 列表、逐节点 seed、树日志、parser 实现或可执行代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On InternVL2.5-78B, the paper reports MMMU-PRO overall accuracy of 0.537 for Socratic-MCTS versus 0.517 for direct answering, and MMStar accuracy of 0.711 versus 0.692. On the filtered English multiple-choice MathVista subset, it reports 0.782 versus 0.740 for direct answering. The largest highlighted MMMU-PRO change is a nine-percentage-point gain in Liberal Arts; STEM+B changes from 0.507 direct to 0.492 under Socratic-MCTS. Least-To-Most underperforms direct and CoT in the reported tables.

The results show that this search configuration can improve aggregate answer selection on the studied frozen VLM and benchmarks, with uneven effects across domains. They do not prove that generated subquestions are faithful, node values are calibrated, or internal agreement is a reliable verifier. The paper reports single runs and no broad hyperparameter tuning. The official ACL paper, DOI, pages, and citation are verified; no official code, data, or search-log artifact was confirmed.

在 InternVL2.5-78B 上，论文报告 Socratic-MCTS 的 MMMU-PRO 总体准确率为 0.537，Direct Answer 为 0.517；MMStar 为 0.711 对 0.692。在筛选后的 MathVista 英文多选子集上，报告为 0.782 对 0.740。MMMU-PRO 中最突出的变化是 Liberal Arts 提升 9 个百分点；STEM+B 则从 Direct Answer 的 0.507 变为 Socratic-MCTS 的 0.492。报告表格中，Least-To-Most 低于 direct 与 CoT。

这些结果说明，在所研究冻结 VLM 与 benchmark 上，该搜索配置可以改善总体答案选择，但不同领域效果不均。它们不能证明生成 subquestion 忠实、节点价值已校准或内部一致性是可靠 verifier。论文报告单次运行，也未进行广泛 hyperparameter tuning。ACL 正式论文、DOI、页码与引文已核实；未确认官方代码、数据或搜索日志 artifact。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The method's main change is the semantic search unit. Rather than branching over tokens or fixed reasoning steps, it branches over dynamically generated questions, then answers each new question with a decoupled policy call to reduce propagation of the current path's mistakes. Node evaluation composes the path back into a final-answer context and uses several wrap-up-conditioned completions, while confidence gating and direct-exit nodes avoid spending the full budget on every item.

MCTS, UCT, self-consistency, question decomposition, and early exit are established components. Socratic-MCTS combines them into a multimodal test-time trajectory whose nodes have interpretable question–answer content. For this atlas, the direction signal is that visual search data should preserve both semantic actions and the internal-agreement machinery. Benchmark accuracy is the end-to-end quality signal; it does not validate individual subquestions, answers, weights, or tree branches.

该方法的主要变化是语义搜索单元。它不在 token 或固定推理 step 上分支，而是在动态生成的问题上分支；每个新问题再通过解耦的 policy call 独立回答，以减少当前路径错误的传播。节点评估会把路径重新组合进最终答案上下文，并使用多个受 wrap-up phrase 条件化的 completion；置信 gate 与 direct-exit node 则避免每个条目都消耗完整预算。

MCTS、UCT、self-consistency、问题分解与 early exit 都是既有组件。Socratic-MCTS 将它们组合成节点含可解释问答内容的多模态测试时轨迹。对本图谱而言，方向信号是视觉搜索数据应同时保留语义 action 和内部一致性机制。Benchmark 准确率是端到端质量信号，并不能验证单个 subquestion、answer、weight 或 tree branch。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper notes that structured, non-autoregressive search is less GPU-efficient than simple generation and may be less practical than brute-force majority voting. Internal agreement is vulnerable to correlated errors: frozen VLMs can be overconfident, ignore CoT cues, or generate insufficiently diverse completions. The reported STEM+B result illustrates that aggregate gains do not imply uniform domain gains. Search termination on empty or repetitive output is a heuristic, not task correctness.

The study uses one large frozen VLM, single runs, fixed iteration budgets, and no broad hyperparameter or multi-agent study. Model token probabilities, verbosity penalties, transition phrases, parser behavior, and early-exit calibration can all affect the tree. No confirmed release exposes complete trees, rejected subquestions, node scores, random seeds, prompts, or software environment. Thus the method is not currently replayable as a trace dataset, and benchmark improvements cannot serve as evidence that its intermediate reasoning is faithful or high quality.

论文指出，结构化、非自回归搜索的 GPU 效率低于简单生成，实际可用性可能不如暴力 majority voting。内部一致性会受到相关错误影响：冻结 VLM 可能过度自信、忽略 CoT cue，或产生缺乏多样性的 completion。报告中的 STEM+B 结果也说明总体增益不代表所有领域均有增益。以空输出或重复输出终止搜索只是启发式规则，不是任务正确性判定。

研究只使用一个大型冻结 VLM、单次运行和固定 iteration budget，也未广泛研究 hyperparameter 或 multi-agent 设置。模型 token probability、verbosity penalty、transition phrase、parser 行为与 early-exit 校准都可能改变搜索树。未确认的发布无法提供完整树、被拒 subquestion、节点分数、随机 seed、prompt 或软件环境。因此，该方法目前不能作为可回放轨迹数据集，benchmark 改善也不能证明中间推理忠实或高质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Socratic-MCTS broadens the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track beyond text-only math and code. It supplies a concrete schema in which an action is a subquestion, a state includes a subanswer, the value comes from weighted internal agreement, and the budget is measured in MCTS iterations and rollouts. It is useful for comparing semantic tree search with flat best-of-N or prompt-only decomposition.

A reusable visual-search record should include the image identifier and license, benchmark item and split, model/version, root answer and confidence, confidence estimator, search-gate decision, parent node, subquestion candidates, isolated subanswers, transition phrase, terminal reason, UCT components, eight rollout completions, parsed choices, heuristic weights, agreement value, backpropagated statistics, direct-exit status, iteration count, final answer, and ground-truth evaluation. The ground-truth label should remain separate from the internal value signal. Without released logs, the paper is an evaluation recipe rather than a trace-data source.

Socratic-MCTS 将 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 分类扩展到纯文本数学与代码之外。它提供了具体 schema：action 是 subquestion，state 含 subanswer，value 来自加权内部一致性，预算由 MCTS iteration 与 rollout 数量表示。该工作可用于比较语义树搜索、平坦 best-of-N 与仅靠 prompt 的分解。

可复用视觉搜索记录应包含图像标识与许可证、benchmark 条目与 split、模型/版本、root answer 与置信度、置信估计器、search-gate 决策、parent node、候选 subquestion、独立 subanswer、transition phrase、终止原因、UCT 分量、八个 rollout completion、解析选项、启发式权重、一致性 value、回传统计、direct-exit 状态、iteration 数、最终答案和 ground-truth evaluation。Ground-truth label 必须与内部 value signal 分开。缺少发布日志时，该论文是评测配方，而非轨迹数据源。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Actions are subquestions and node states pair each subquestion with an isolated subanswer.
  • Value estimation uses eight wrap-up-conditioned completions and heuristic-weighted internal agreement.
  • Reported settings use temperature 0.6, UCT constant 1.4, and a 0.9 confidence gate.
  • Evaluation uses single runs with 40 iterations on MMMU-PRO and 20 on MMStar and MathVista.
  • No official tree logs or code were confirmed; benchmark gains do not validate reasoning faithfulness.

• Action 是 subquestion，node state 将每个 subquestion 与独立 subanswer 配对。
  • Value estimation 使用八个受 wrap-up phrase 条件化的 completion 和启发式加权内部一致性。
  • 报告设置为 temperature 0.6、UCT constant 1.4、置信 gate 0.9。
  • 评测为单次运行：MMMU-PRO 40 次 iteration，MMStar 与 MathVista 20 次。
  • 未确认官方树日志或代码；benchmark 增益不能验证推理忠实性。
